blocks.text: CEBU, PHILIPPINES—Pageants have long served as platforms for charitable efforts, and this year’s edition of the Miss Asia Pacific International competition is no exception, with the delegates spending time with special children. The international pageant’s “Charity Day” had the 38 delegates spending time with neurodivergent individuals and persons with disabilities at Casino Español de Cebu in Cebu City the whole day on Monday, Oct. 5. During the event, the ladies joined the children in making arts and crafts using discarded cores of toilet paper rolls.
